name: Active Transmutation
blueprintProse:
Active Transmutation systematically converts passive constructions into active voice: [Agent/Subject] + [Transitive Verb] + [Direct Object]. It eliminates passive auxiliary verbs and trailing prepositions, ensuring that sentences clearly identify who is taking action. 
Neurolinguistic research reveals that the human brain processes subject-verb-object structures with lower metabolic cognitive load than inverted passive arrangements. Passive sentences obscure agency, causing minor interpretive delays that dilute persuasive impact. Active constructions establish clear agency, improving reading comprehension and driving user momentum.
template: Transform: [Object] is operated by [Agent] [Agent] [Direct Active Action Verb] [Object] [Measurable Consequence]

example.bland: Scalable data infrastructure is built by our engineers, and cloud configurations are monitored continuously by the automation platform to prevent downtime.
example.optimized: Our engineers build scalable data infrastructure. The automation platform monitors your cloud configurations 24/7 to prevent downtime.
